This category is reserved for topics regarding the fundamental nature of reality in the '''The Wheel of Time''' books, especially observations made at a higher level than is observed by the characters in-world. These articles relate to the magical forces, unexplained phenomena, nature of time, alternative realities, souls, philosophy and religion. Much of the material is supplied by [[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]], [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], [[Origins of the Wheel of Time]], interviews with the authors and [[Team Jordan]], [[Robert Jordan's notes]] and long-standing discussions with the fandom.
